title: Hello there. New to the forum

posts.author: GYIYGABITE
posts.body:
Heyooo everyone!
Brand new to the forum. For a year now, I've been making my game using RPG Maker MZ. Even though it has been a year, I thought it was time that I would join the forum and ask for guidance.
At the same time, help out as well in any way I can.
A pleasure to say hello to everyone here. Have a good one!

Click to expand...
Gladly. So for starters, I am making my own assets using the Aseprite. In addition, I am going to use some of VisustellaMZ plugins for my games. With their plugins, I have an idea what mechanics I am planning to implement:
Combat is going to be max of three party members and is going to be turned-based, similar to Octopath Traveler's combat but just the turn order.
Similar to FF7's Equipping materia mechanic, players can equip "Multiple" runes granting access to certain magic and they can loose that access as well if they unequip it. For the moment, I'm not planning to implement that the runes can level up and become powerful.
I also want to implement a system where players obtain "AP" and use them to spend on unlocking passive bonuses and upgrading their unique abilities.
Similar to FF9's ability equipment mechanic, another idea I was thinking in but I haven't decided yet is to have the characters equip certain passive abilities once they unlock it so players can customize their characters.
One thing I want to do but I can't seem to find is go beyond Visustella's paramaters and modify the javascript so I can make some changes for example, having a Save/Load menu instead of it being seperate and also to change the menu interface sizes. I have 0 XP in java coding so if there are tutorial videos or posts that can help me, that would be great.

posts.author: Ulqiuo
posts.body:
That's awesome to hear - Aseprite's a great tool for artwork. I can't say much about Visustella as I'm not an MZ user, but it sounds quite in-depth!
Liking the variety of concepts you're using - just recently played the OG Final Fantasy 7 again and I must admit the materia system is cracking - are you thinking of using a link based system like it? Like how you can use an 'all' materia with a 'lightning' one to hit all enemies, or something to that effect?
The equipment option's a good call for the true tweakers out there. The ability to setup your characters how you want is a great boon for the perfectionists out there. Because there's such a sheer variety of effects you could feasibly give to the characters it'd be a great way to truly deepen your combat system (and other areas too).
As I'm not any help with regards to Visustella I'd recommend going to the other sections of the forums to ask for help. This one seems to be a good place to start:
JS Plugin Releases (RMMZ)
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
...But I apologise if it's the wrong section. I'm a bit new to all this myself haha. I believe it's a few scrolls down from the forum's front page.
Either way though, it's sounding like a proper adventure! I wish you the best of times in furthering your project. Knock 'em dead!
